propositions: Type mapping must be config-driven per project via type_map axis, with SKIP sentinel for per-project exclusion, replacing hard-coded LOCAL_TYPE_TO_JIRA and EXCLUDED_SYNC_TYPES.
Fail-closed validation fires once at compute_outbound_mutations start (before mutation loop) when a syncable type is undecided (unmapped and not SKIP).
New rebar-type: annotation label stamps Jira issues when local types collapse lossy (forward target does not reverse-map to source local type), requiring jira_to_local_type reverse map.
Type mapping must be threaded through all three OutboundMapper implementations and both field mapper bodies (Cloud, DC, protocol) alongside status_map.
Per-project excluded set = EXCLUDED_SYNC_TYPES ∪ {types mapped to SKIP}, consumed at both create-absent and loop sites in outbound_differ.

Inbound recovery via recover_type_label restores rebar-type: labels without reverse mapping; rebar-type: prefix must be filtered from four label-prefix tuples and internal-tag tuples across differ modules.
